## Intro
This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to use the Force Feedback feature of the Teslasuit device. The page is structured to help developers understand the process of initializing the Teslasuit API, connecting to a device, configuring force feedback parameters, and enabling/disabling force feedback.

## Code for Force Feedback
````python
import time
from teslasuit_sdk import ts_api
from teslasuit_sdk.ts_mapper import TsBone2dIndex
from teslasuit_sdk.subsystems.ts_magnetic_encoder import (
    TsForceFeedbackLockDirection, TsForceFeedbackConfig)

# Force feedback parameters — adjust to change the resistance feeling
FF_BONE             = TsBone2dIndex.RightThumbProximal  # which finger joint to restrict
FF_ANGLE_DEG        = 45   # maximum allowed joint angle in degrees (0–90)
FF_HARDNESS_PERCENT = 100  # resistance level when the angle limit is reached (0–100%)
FF_DURATION_S       = 10   # seconds to hold force feedback before releasing

def main():
    try:
        print("Initialize API")
        api = ts_api.TsApi()  # create the central API object

        print("Waiting for a Teslasuit device to connect...")
        device = api.get_device_manager().get_or_wait_last_device_attached()

        print("Accessing the Magnetic Encoder subsystem...")
        encoder = device.magnetic_encoder  # drives the Teslaglove servomotors

        print("Set force feedback angle")
        ff_config = [TsForceFeedbackConfig()]
        ff_config[0].bone_index       = FF_BONE.value
        ff_config[0].angle            = FF_ANGLE_DEG
        ff_config[0].hardness_percent = FF_HARDNESS_PERCENT
        # Both: resist movement in both flexion and extension past the angle limit
        ff_config[0].lock_direction   = TsForceFeedbackLockDirection.Both.value
        encoder.ts_force_feedback_enable(ff_config)

        time.sleep(FF_DURATION_S)  # hold the feedback for the configured duration

        print("Release force feedback")
        encoder.ts_force_feedback_disable([FF_BONE.value])
        print("Finished")

    except (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit):
        print('\n! Received keyboard interrupt, quitting glove forcefeedback\n')

main()
````

## Expected output
```
Initialize API
Waiting for a Teslasuit device to connect...
Accessing the Magnetic Encoder subsystem...
Set force feedback angle
Release force feedback
Finished
```
